story.iWant: a simple 3-button modal to choose my recording mode
story.soThat: I can quickly start recording without configuration dialogs
story.tasks: - Add Record button to sidebar (AC: 1) - Create recording store (AC: 8, 9) - Create RecordingModeModal component (AC: 2, 3) - Implement mode selection buttons (AC: 4, 5) - Implement dark theme styling (AC: 7) - Integrate IPC communication (AC: 10) - Create IPC handler stub (AC: 10) - Wire up cancel functionality (AC: 6) - Add component tests - Create Recording component README

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: "Record" button added to left sidebar (Sidebar.tsx) with recording icon
`RecordingModeModal.tsx` component created with 3 mode buttons: "Screen Only", "Webcam Only", "Screen + Webcam (PiP)"
Modal opens when user clicks "Record" button in sidebar
"Screen + Webcam (PiP)" button visually highlighted as recommended/default option
Clicking any mode button triggers recording start and closes modal
Modal includes cancel button to close without starting recording
Modal styled with dark theme consistent with CapCut reference design
`recordingStore.ts` Zustand store created with minimal state: `isRecording`, `mode`, `duration`, `outputFiles`
IPC integration: clicking mode button invokes `'recording:start'` IPC channel with selected mode

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification
doc.snippet: RecordingModeModal with 3-button modal: Screen Only / Webcam Only / Screen + Webcam (PiP). No source selectors, no preview controls, no configuration screens.

doc.snippet: recordingStore with minimal state: isRecording, mode, duration, outputFiles. Actions: startRecording(mode), stopRecording(), updateDuration(duration).

doc.snippet: IPC channel 'recording:start' with RecordingMode parameter. Response: IPCResponse with success boolean.

Shared button component for consistent styling of mode selection buttons
Pattern for UI state management including modal open/close logic to replicate for recording modal

node.package: Icon library for recording button icons

constraints.constraint: RecordingModeModal must live in src/renderer/components/Recording/ directory
recordingStore must follow Zustand pattern at src/renderer/store/recordingStore.ts
IPC handler must be in src/main/ipc/recording.handlers.ts
NO source selection dropdowns - mode selection only
NO preview window before recording - instant start
NO configuration options (resolution, framerate) - just mode selection
PiP mode must be visually highlighted as recommended/default
Dark theme styling must match existing CapCut-inspired design
Must use Radix UI Dialog components for modal (existing pattern)
Must integrate with existing uiStore for modal open/close state

interface.name: recordingStore
IPC: recording:start
interface.signature: ipcRenderer.invoke('recording:start', { mode: RecordingMode }) => IPCResponse<{ success: boolean }>
